mods.name: Rift Anchoring
mods.description:
Rift Anchoring - A Chunk Loader Mod

Features:
1. 3x3 Obsidian base detection: Build a 3x3 obsidian platform and place a Respawn Anchor on top center.
2. Chunk loading: Right-click with Infinite Glowstone to force-load the chunk indefinitely.
3. Automatic energy consumption (configurable interval, default 1 hour per level).
4. Infinite Glowstone crafting via Smithing Table (template + nether star) or Anvil (enchanted book).
5. "Cloud Stone" easter egg: Rename Infinite Glowstone to "云石" for angel-themed effects.
6. Spawn point disabled in multiblock structure.
7. Persistent visual effects (particles, sounds).
8. Destruction penalty on base break.
9. Chunk Debug Wand for inspecting chunk loading status.

Usage:
1. Build a 3x3 obsidian floor.
2. Place a Respawn Anchor in the center on top.
3. Use Infinite Glowstone to activate permanent chunk loading.
4. Break any obsidian to stop chunk loading (with penalty effects).

Configuration: config/rift-anchoring-common.toml

releases.notes:
# Changelog

## [1.2.0] - 2026-06-02

### Added
[+] Iron ingot recipe for Lodestone (8 Chiseled Stone Bricks + 1 Iron Ingot) - backports Minecraft 1.21.5 recipe
[+] Custom Echo Shard crafting recipe (4 Amethyst Shards + 1 Sculk = 1 Echo Shard) - configurable via config
[+] Configuration option `enableEchoShardRecipe` to toggle Echo Shard recipe (default: true)
[+] Configuration option `lodestoneRecipe` to choose between iron/netherite/both recipes (default: both)
[+] Configuration option `enableLodestoneDebugLog` for detailed lodestone operation logging
[+] Lodestone structure formation effects (particle burst + sound) when multiblock is first completed
[+] Lodestone beam visual feedback - shows when unbound, hides when bound to an active anchor

### Changed
[\~] Lodestone beam now hides when bound to an active anchor, reappears when anchor loses energy or is destroyed
[\~] Improved particle effects for lodestone beam (height increased to 10 blocks, better density falloff)
[\~] Enhanced lodestone binding beam effect (sine wave wobble, smoother particle flow)
[\~] Updated README with complete feature documentation and language switching (English/Chinese)

### Fixed
[\~] Fixed incorrect iron ingot recipe pattern (was 8 iron + 1 chiseled stone bricks, now 8 chiseled stone bricks + 1 iron)
[\~] Fixed cross-dimensional data leakage in SavedData - now properly isolates data per dimension
[\~] Fixed state not saving immediately after deactivation - now saves to disk on every state change
[\~] Fixed anchor respawning after server restart when deactivated before periodic save

---

## [1.0.0] - 2026-06-02

### Initial Release
[+] Rift Respawn Anchor multiblock structure (3x3 obsidian base + Respawn Anchor)
[+] Rift Lodestone multiblock structure (3x3 obsidian base + Lodestone)
[+] Chunk loading via Glowstone (consumable) or Infinite Glowstone (permanent)
[+] Infinite Glowstone crafting via Anvil (Glowstone + Enchanted Book) or Smithing Table (Glowstone + Nether Star + Template)
[+] Anchor Guide Compass for tracking bound lodestones
[+] Chunk Debug Wand for debugging chunk loading status
[+] Persistent visual effects and destruction penalties
[+] Configuration system for energy intervals, crafting methods, and debug options
